description: This file contains functions and types for processing Discord account statuses, application summaries, permission audits, and generating status issues related to Discord channels within a larger application.

methods.name: readDiscordAccountStatus
methods.description: Reads and constructs a DiscordAccountStatus object from a ChannelAccountSnapshot.

methods.name: readDiscordApplicationSummary
methods.description: Extracts and constructs a DiscordApplicationSummary from an unknown value.

methods.name: readDiscordPermissionsAuditSummary
methods.description: Parses and constructs a DiscordPermissionsAuditSummary from an unknown value.
